reviews.review_text:
Anh Amắn 🇻🇳
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam12939 contributions

Good place for celebration/party dinners
Oct 2022 • Friends
My friend suggested here for a mid week dinner catch up as he knows I love seafood and also like trying new/unique places. This place ticks all boxes. Firstly please note there are two of the same restaurant - one is more traditional the other is this one which is aimed at a younger dinning crowd with dance music. 

This restaurant is on the 15th floor rooftop of a building, you catch a lift to the 14th floor & walk up stairs to get to the rooftop. It is open to the sky with great views. As in local dining restaurants in Vietnam you select a beer and a tub of it is brought to your table covered in ice and as your table drinks it your empties are discarded into another tub and these are counted at the night for payment. Here the custom is also to drink the beer with ice so your beer glass is regularly topped up with large chunks of ice. Just let them know if you prefer no ice.

The food was simply delicious, and there is much variety, the two of us ate a lot from oysters, to a whole fish, to squid, to a variety of seafood i had not eaten before. All were fresh and accompanied by a variety of sauces- some very hot, so if you like spicy like me you have choices.

Midweek it was crowded with groups of dinners, i think we were the only table of two. Most people were celebrating something, yet due to the open air it did not feel overly crowded or noisy from other dinners. Service was excellent and prompt. The only thing that was a bit much for me was the dance music which created a night club vibe. But then again I am 56yo and the place is really aimed at people in their 20-30’s with a young staff. So i accept i am not its target demographic, their second restaurant is more for my age group. Regardless I overall enjoyed this dining experience and so did everyone else eating there. It is definitely unique and if you are a younger group it is absolutely perfect.

Finally the price was surprisingly low for all that we ate and drank. So definitely great value for money too!
